diff:
--- rules/color_notifications/baseline/color_notifications.yar
+++ rules/color_notifications/formatted/color_notifications.yar
@@ -1,56 +1,75 @@
 private rule cn_has_notification_channel {
     strings:
-        $notify = "notify" nocase
+        $notify       = "notify" nocase
         $notification = "notification" nocase
-        $webhook = "webhook" nocase
-        $alert = "alert" nocase
+        $webhook      = "webhook" nocase
+        $alert        = "alert" nocase
+
     condition:
         any of them
 }
 
 private rule cn_red_vocabulary {
     strings:
-        $red = "red" nocase
+        $red     = "red" nocase
         $crimson = "crimson" nocase
         $scarlet = "scarlet" nocase
+
     condition:
-        2 of ($red, $crimson, $scarlet) or #red >= 2
+        (
+            2 of ($red, $crimson, $scarlet)
+            or #red >= 2
+        )
 }
 
 rule ColorNotification_Red {
     strings:
         $badge = "RED_NOTIFICATION"
-        $ui = "color-red"
+        $ui    = "color-red"
+
     condition:
-        (cn_red_vocabulary and cn_has_notification_channel) or
-        ($badge and cn_has_notification_channel)
+        (
+            cn_red_vocabulary
+            and cn_has_notification_channel
+        )
+        or (
+            $badge
+            and cn_has_notification_channel
+        )
 }
 
 rule ColorNotification_Amber {
     strings:
-        $amber = "amber" nocase
-        $orange = "orange" nocase
+        $amber   = "amber" nocase
+        $orange  = "orange" nocase
         $warning = "warning" nocase
+
     condition:
-        ($amber or $orange) and ($warning or cn_has_notification_channel) and
-        #warning >= 2
+        (
+            ($amber or $orange)
+            and ($warning or cn_has_notification_channel)
+            and #warning >= 2
+        )
 }
 
 rule ColorNotification_Green {
     strings:
-        $green = "green" nocase
+        $green   = "green" nocase
         $emerald = "emerald" nocase
         $success = "success" nocase
+
     condition:
-        all of ($green, $emerald) and
-        ($success or cn_has_notification_channel)
+        all of ($green, $emerald)
+        and ($success or cn_has_notification_channel)
 }
 
 rule ColorNotification_Blue {
     strings:
-        $blue = "blue" nocase
+        $blue  = "blue" nocase
         $azure = "azure" nocase
-        $info = "info" nocase
+        $info  = "info" nocase
+
     condition:
-        1 of ($blue, $azure) and ($info or cn_has_notification_channel)
+        1 of ($blue, $azure)
+        and ($info or cn_has_notification_channel)
 }
